context: Kenji and Daichi take a long road trip together; tunes and chat.
purpose: Two friends bonding on long drive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Long drive — first one in ages.
lines.style: Soft opening, warm nostalgic tone. Gentle pace. Voice settles into comfort, like he's already relaxing. The dash before 'first' has a beat of pause.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: Yeah — good to get away like this.
lines.style: Immediate agreement, easy laugh underneath. Warm Kansai drawl on the yeah. Leans back slightly. Content and unhurried.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: いつ以来やろ、こんなんで二人?
lines.en: When was the last time it was just us two?
lines.style: Soft, turning inward. Searching tone — genuinely wondering, not rhetorical. Slight wonder at the realization. Pace slows as he thinks.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Quiet certainty with a smile in it. Soft, almost to himself. Trailing off into memory. The Kansai lilt natural, unhurried.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: We used to travel everywhere back then.
lines.style: Warm affection for the memory. Slight wistfulness layered under. Pace easy, conversational. Voice has the texture of something cherished.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 責任、増えてもうたしな。
lines.en: Life added weight. More things to carry.
lines.style: Gentle acceptance, not complaint. Measured tone. A small sigh-breath beneath the words. Matter-of-fact but kind.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: たまには、こうやって息抜きや。
lines.en: That's why moments like this matter.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Slow, deliberate pace. Opens with weight, resolves with gentleness. Philosophical but grounded — no performance.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: It's easier to breathe when you're here.
lines.style: Vulnerable without asking for reassurance. Soft, direct. Almost confesional. Voice steady but tender — this is what he means.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: One word, all sincerity. Warm, held. A full answer because they don't need more. Kansai rhythm carries it.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: Next service area — we stop there?
lines.style: Practical, warm. The question is tender inside. Gentle shift to the present. Checking in softly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええで、コーヒー欲しい。
lines.en: Yeah, sounds good. Coffee sounds perfect.
lines.style: Eager but not rushed. Brightness returns. Easy agreement. The Kansai warmth full in his voice now.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Satisfied, closing a small moment well. Warm finality. A smile in the voice. Simple, content.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: I'm glad we get to talk like this.
lines.style: Soft gratitude, unguarded. Slow pace, each word held. Kansai warmth at full. The 'I'm glad' is honest, not performed.
